```{r TableS3,  results = "asis", out.width = "100%"}

# Supplementary Table: Baseline characteristics by longitudinal MRS availability

baseline_data <- NeuroMET %>% filter(visit == "t1", !is.na(mrs_availability))

# 2. Sample size per group
n_counts_mrs <- baseline_data %>%
  count(mrs_availability) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("n = ", n)) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mrs_availability, values_from = label) %>%
  mutate(variable = "Sample size")

# 3. Continuous variables: mean [95% CI] + normality-informed test choice
vars_cont <- c("age", "edu", "mmse", "nmm", "glu", "gaba", "glu_gaba", "pTau", "GFAP")

cont_summary_mrs <- vars_cont %>%
  map_dfr(function(var) {
    baseline_data %>%
      group_by(mrs_availability) %>%
      summarise(
        mean = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
        se   = sd(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(.data[[var]]))),
        n    = sum(!is.na(.data[[var]])),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        ci_low  = mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
        ci_high = mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
        mean_ci = if (var %in% c("age", "edu", "mmse", "glu")) {
          sprintf("%.1f [%.1f;%.1f]", mean, ci_low, ci_high)
        } else {
          sprintf("%.2f [%.2f;%.2f]", mean, ci_low, ci_high)
        },
        variable = var
      ) %>%
      select(variable, mrs_availability, mean_ci)
  })

cont_table_wide_mrs <- cont_summary_mrs %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mrs_availability, values_from = mean_ci)

# Choose t-test vs. Wilcoxon per variable based on Shapiro-Wilk normality in both groups
pvals_cont_mrs <- vars_cont %>%
  map_dfr(function(var) {
    g1 <- baseline_data %>% filter(mrs_availability == "Repeat MRS (≥2 visits)") %>% pull(.data[[var]]) %>% na.omit()
    g2 <- baseline_data %>% filter(mrs_availability == "Baseline MRS only") %>% pull(.data[[var]]) %>% na.omit()

    normal_ok <- tryCatch({
      shapiro.test(g1)$p.value > 0.05 && shapiro.test(g2)$p.value > 0.05
    }, error = function(e) FALSE)  # shapiro.test fails if n<3; treat as non-normal

    if (normal_ok) {
      pval <- t.test(g1, g2)$p.value
      test_used <- "t-test"
    } else {
      pval <- wilcox.test(g1, g2)$p.value
      test_used <- "Wilcoxon"
    }

    tibble(variable = var, `p-value` = sprintf("%.3f", pval), test = test_used)
  })

cont_table_wide_mrs <- cont_table_wide_mrs %>%
  left_join(pvals_cont_mrs, by = "variable")

# 4. Categorical variables: sex, APOEε4
categorical_vars <- c("sex", "APOEe4")

cat_summary_mrs <- categorical_vars %>%
  map_dfr(function(var) {
    baseline_data %>%
      group_by(mrs_availability, value = .data[[var]]) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(mrs_availability) %>%
      mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100,
             label = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 0), "%)"),
             variable = paste0(var, " = ", value)) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(variable, mrs_availability, label)
  })

cat_table_wide_mrs <- cat_summary_mrs %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mrs_availability, values_from = label)

pvals_cat_mrs <- categorical_vars %>%
  map_dfr(function(var) {
    tbl <- table(baseline_data[[var]], baseline_data$mrs_availability)
    pval <- tryCatch({
      if (any(tbl < 5)) fisher.test(tbl)$p.value else chisq.test(tbl)$p.value
    }, error = function(e) NA)
    test_used <- if (any(tbl < 5)) "Fisher" else "chi-square"
    tibble(base_var = var, `p-value` = ifelse(is.na(pval), NA, sprintf("%.3f", pval)), test = test_used)
  })

pvals_cat_mrs_2 <- tibble(
  variable = c("sex = 0", "sex = 1", "APOEe4 = non-carrier", "APOEe4 = carrier"),
  `p-value` = c(pvals_cat_mrs$`p-value`[1], pvals_cat_mrs$`p-value`[1],
                pvals_cat_mrs$`p-value`[2], pvals_cat_mrs$`p-value`[2]),
  test = c(pvals_cat_mrs$test[1], pvals_cat_mrs$test[1],
           pvals_cat_mrs$test[2], pvals_cat_mrs$test[2])
)

cat_table_wide_mrs <- cat_table_wide_mrs %>%
  left_join(pvals_cat_mrs_2, by = "variable")

# 5. Combine
final_table_mrs <- bind_rows(n_counts_mrs, cont_table_wide_mrs, cat_table_wide_mrs) %>%
  select(variable, `Repeat MRS (≥2 visits)`, `Baseline MRS only`, `p-value`, test) %>%
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable == "sex = 1" ~ "Sex = Female",
    variable == "sex = 0" ~ "Sex = Male",
    TRUE ~ variable
  )) %>%
  filter(!(variable %in% c("Sex = Male", "APOEe4 = non-carrier")))

final_table_mrs_cleaned <- final_table_mrs %>%
  mutate(variable = case_when(
    variable == "age" ~ "Age [years]",
    variable == "Sex = Female" ~ "Sex (Female)",
    variable == "edu" ~ "Education [years]",
    variable == "APOEe4 = carrier" ~ "APOEε4 (carrier)",
    variable == "mmse" ~ "MMSE",
    variable == "nmm" ~ "Memory (NMM)",
    variable == "glu" ~ "MRS Glutamate [mmol/L]",
    variable == "gaba" ~ "MRS GABA [mmol/L]",
    variable == "glu_gaba" ~ "log(Glutamate/GABA)",
    variable == "pTau" ~ "Plasma pTau-181 [pg/mL]",
    variable == "GFAP" ~ "GFAP [pg/mL]",
    TRUE ~ variable
  ))

desired_order <- c("Sample size", "Age [years]", "Sex (Female)", "Education [years]",
                    "APOEε4 (carrier)", "MMSE", "Memory (NMM)", "MRS Glutamate [mmol/L]",
                    "MRS GABA [mmol/L]", "log(Glutamate/GABA)", "Plasma pTau-181 [pg/mL]", "GFAP [pg/mL]")

final_table_mrs_ordered <- final_table_mrs_cleaned %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = desired_order)) %>%
  arrange(variable) %>%
  mutate(`p-value` = ifelse(as.numeric(`p-value`) <= 0.001, "<0.001", `p-value`))

final_table_mrs_ordered %>%
  kable(
    format = "html",
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c("Variable", "Repeat MRS (≥2 visits)", "Baseline MRS only", "p-value", "Test"),
    caption = "<b>Supplementary Table S3: Baseline characteristics by longitudinal MRS availability.</b> Participants are grouped by whether they contributed a glutamate measurement at ≥2 visits (Repeat MRS) or only at visit 1 (Baseline MRS only); participants with no MRS data at any visit (n=8) are excluded, consistent with the main analytic sample. Continuous variables are compared via Welch's t-test or Wilcoxon rank-sum test depending on normality (Shapiro-Wilk, P>0.05 in both groups); categorical variables via chi-square or Fisher's exact test depending on expected cell counts.",
    align = "c"
  ) %>%
  kable_paper()
    
```
